info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Tax Rate Configurations API
Return the data for all TaxRateConfigurations

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter TaxRateConfiguration records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter TaxRateConfiguration records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: include_system
params.description: When true (default), system tax rates ("Do not apply tax", "Tax exempt") are included in the response. Pass include_system=false to exclude them.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of TaxRateConfiguration records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the TaxRateConfiguration records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter TaxRateConfiguration records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

items.docs: A TaxRateConfiguration can not be deleted if it is a system tax rate, has already been deleted, or is in use — set as an invoice default, used on one or more expenses, used on one or more expense categories, or used in one or more unpaid invoices.
